title.narrative: ASEAN-Korea Cooperation for Methane Mitigation

description.narrative: To act as the lead implementing agency of a regional ASEAN cooperation program initiated by the Republic of Korea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The program’s goal is to contribute to methane emission reductions in ASEAN countries by: 1. Supporting the development of enabling policies and institutions 2. Improving methane emissions measurement 3. Designing, financing, and implementing methane emission reduction projects 4. Promoting regional dialogue and partnership

To establish a strong foundation for the reduction of methane emissions at scale in the ASEAN region by (i) developing enabling policies and institutions, (ii) improving the measurement of methane emissions, (iii) designing, financing, and implementing methane emissions reduction projects, and (iv) promoting regional dialogue and partnership.

description.narrative: Two concept notes for scaled-up national-level interventions (per country) endorsed by their respective MRCs.Each concept note should describe an intervention with a budget of at least USD 5M to be considered large-scale.* Total no. of concept notes = 8 countries with MRCs (BN, KH, ID, LA, MY, PH, TH, VN) x 2 = 16.

title.narrative: Participating AMS have originated at least two national-level interventions (policy, financing, or both) for reducing methane emissions at scale as a follow-up to this project based on enhanced capacity and lessons learned.
To achieve a regional reduction in methane emissions at scale, thereby contributing to the vision of a sustainable ASEAN community that balances social development and environmental protection.
